# google-cloud-python/packages/google-resumable-media/docs at main · googleapis/google-cloud-python · GitHub

Source: https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-python/tree/main/packages/google-resumable-media/docs

Utilities for Google Media Downloads and Resumable Uploads

See the [docs](https://googleapis.dev/python/google-resumable-media/latest/index.html) for examples and usage.

While still in development and subject to change, this library has asyncio support at google._async_resumable_media.

Python >= 3.10

Python <= 3.9

Apache 2.0 - See [the LICENSE](https://github.com/googleapis/google-resumable-media-python/blob/main/LICENSE) for more information.
